overview_description.description:
Xkit is an integration platform that creates synergies between different applications.

It features encrypted token storage, cross-site request forgery (CSRF) mitigation and an application programming interface (API) that lets a company's customers connect different apps to the company's own app while obtaining access tokens in a few lines of code, with or without a backend, enabling businesses to increase the usefulness of its applications through integration.
